description.ja: 『魔神創造伝ワタル』より皇龍丸が登場！
• 部位ごとにパーツを分けられるシリーズ共通フレームを採用。他の魔神と組み合わせて遊ぼう！
description.en: • Adopts a common frame across the series that allows parts to be separated by area. Let's play in combination with other genies!

description.ja: • パチパチと手で外せるタッチゲート仕様。接着剤無しで組み立てられる！
description.en: • Touch gate design that can be removed by hand. Can be assembled without adhesive!

description.ja: • 両肩の皇龍頭などはゴールドメタリックパーツで再現！
description.en: • The imperial dragon heads on both shoulders are reproduced with gold metallic parts!

description.ja: • 皇龍杖の皇輪はブルーのクリアパーツで再現！
description.en: • The imperial ring of the Imperial Dragon Staff is reproduced with blue clear parts!
